description: Every task on the board, with the column it is in. "columns" is in board order from first to last, so a task's "List" tells you how far along it is. ALWAYS refer to a task by its "Title" when you talk to a person: the Title is what is written on the Trello card, and the "Task ID" appears nowhere a person can see, so naming a task by its id gives them something they cannot find on their own board. Use "Task ID" only to match a task between calls and to pass to move_task.

board.description: Board name or id. Omit when one is configured.
